除錯 SQL（參數已代入）

                WITH IndicatorParsed AS (
                    SELECT
                        date,
                        code,
                        name,
                        CAST(close_price AS REAL) AS close_p,

                        -- 均線解析
                        CAST(json_extract(m_ma, '$.ma5') AS REAL) AS ma5,
                        CAST(json_extract(m_ma, '$.ma10') AS REAL) AS ma10,
                        CAST(json_extract(m_ma, '$.ma20') AS REAL) AS ma20,
                        LAG(CAST(json_extract(m_ma, '$.ma20') AS REAL)) OVER (PARTITION BY code ORDER BY date) AS prev_ma20,

                        -- 成交量解析
                        CAST(json_extract(s_vol, '$.current') AS REAL) AS vol_cur,
                        CAST(json_extract(s_vol, '$.ma5') AS REAL) AS vol_ma5,

                        -- MACD 柱狀體解析
                        CAST(json_extract(s_macd, '$.osc') AS REAL) AS osc,
                        LAG(CAST(json_extract(s_macd, '$.osc') AS REAL)) OVER (PARTITION BY code ORDER BY date) AS prev_osc,

                        -- KD 解析
                        CAST(json_extract(s_kd, '$.k') AS REAL) AS k_val,
                        CAST(json_extract(s_kd, '$.d') AS REAL) AS d_val,
                        LAG(CAST(json_extract(s_kd, '$.k') AS REAL)) OVER (PARTITION BY code ORDER BY date) AS prev_k,
                        LAG(CAST(json_extract(s_kd, '$.d') AS REAL)) OVER (PARTITION BY code ORDER BY date) AS prev_d

                    FROM stock_daily
                ),
                PreCalculated AS (
                    SELECT
                        *,
                        -- 在此層明確算出 3 條均線的最大值與最小值，避免 WHERE 誤判為聚合
                        CASE
                            WHEN ma5 >= ma10 AND ma5 >= ma20 THEN ma5
                            WHEN ma10 >= ma5 AND ma10 >= ma20 THEN ma10
                            ELSE ma20
                        END AS ma_max,
                        CASE
                            WHEN ma5 <= ma10 AND ma5 <= ma20 THEN ma5
                            WHEN ma10 <= ma5 AND ma10 <= ma20 THEN ma10
                            ELSE ma20
                        END AS ma_min
                    FROM IndicatorParsed
                )
                SELECT
                    date,
                    code,
                    name,
                    close_p,
                    ma20,
                    ROUND(vol_cur / 1000, 0) AS vol_cur_k,
                    ROUND(vol_ma5 / 1000, 0) AS vol_ma5_k,
                    prev_osc,
                    osc,
                    k_val,
                    d_val
                FROM PreCalculated
                WHERE
                    -- date 欄位可能是 INTEGER，而 debug SQL 將日期代入後是文字常值；
                    -- 統一轉為文字，確保參數化執行與直接執行 debug SQL 結果一致。
                    CAST(date AS TEXT) = CAST('20261028' AS TEXT)
                    AND code GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
                    AND vol_cur >= 500000
                    -- 均線糾結度判斷
                    AND ((ma_max - ma_min) / ma_min) <= 0.035
                    AND ma20 >= prev_ma20
                    AND close_p >= ma20
                    AND ((close_p - ma20) / ma20) <= 0.04

                    -- 量能與動能指標
                    AND vol_cur >= (vol_ma5 * 1.2)
                    -- AND prev_osc <= 0
                    -- AND osc >= 0

                    -- KD 條件
                    AND k_val > d_val
                    AND k_val >= 30
                    AND k_val <= 45
                ORDER BY code ASC;

總結與優先順序

1. 整體市場觀察： 從這五支股票的表現來看，市場資金追逐強勢股的動能依然存在，尤其在特定題材或籌碼集中的個股上表現突出。然而，過熱的指標和爆量下跌的個股也警示著市場波動性高，風險管理的重要性不容忽視。外資動向在這些個股中扮演關鍵角色。

2. 5支股票優先順序 (第1優先投資 → 第5)：

1. 佳大 (2033)： 綜合考量其強勁的多頭趨勢、健康的回檔整理、法人買盤支撐以及技術指標未達極端過熱，是目前最穩健且具上漲潛力的標的。風險與報酬比相對較佳。

2. 天瀚 (6225)： 經過整理後，最後一日強勢表態，帶量上攻並有外資買超，技術指標重置後轉強。若能維持量能，短期爆發力值得期待。但需注意其相對較低的流動性。
3. 冠西電 (2466)： 極端強勢的噴出股，漲停慣性強，外資大買。但過熱的技術指標帶來極高風險，一旦修正可能快速且劇烈。僅適合高風險承受能力、嚴格執行停損的超短線投機者。
4. 騰輝電子-KY (6672)： 處於修正整理階段，外資大賣，MACD死亡交叉。雖然有反彈，但量能不足且趨勢偏弱。短期不具高報酬低風險的吸引力，建議觀望。
5. 德淵 (4720)： 最後一日爆量長黑K線且外資巨額賣超，是明顯的出貨訊號。短期風險極高，不建議介入，應避免。

3. 資金配置建議：
* 佳大 (2033)： 建議配置 40% 資金。
* 天瀚 (6225)： 建議配置 30% 資金。
* 冠西電 (2466)： 建議配置 20% 資金 (且需極小部位試單，分批進場，嚴格停損)。
* 騰輝電子-KY (6672) & 德淵 (4720)： 建議配置 0% 資金，或若為避險需求可考慮反向操作（但不在本次分析範圍）。

4. 本週最需關注的技術訊號：
* 成交量與K線形態的配合： 強勢股能否持續帶量上攻，以及下跌時是否量縮止穩，是判斷短期趨勢延續或反轉的關鍵。特別注意爆量長黑K線（如德淵）和反彈量能不足（如騰輝電子-KY）。
* RSI、KDJ等超買指標的回落情況： 對於像冠西電這樣極度過熱的股票，需密切關注這些指標是否出現高檔鈍化後的向下轉折或死亡交叉，這通常是修正的預警。
* 三大法人籌碼的連續性： 外資的連續買賣超對短期股價影響巨大，需每日追蹤其動向，尤其在關鍵價位附近。

  • 平均每N天漲停: 數字越小表示漲停頻率越高 (如3.5表示平均每3.5天漲停一次)
  • 累積報酬率: 期間內的總報酬，正值表示獲利
  • 勝率: 上漲天數佔比，高勝率表示穩定性較好
  • 高CP值標的: 漲停次數多 + 高報酬率 + 低跌停風險

除錯 SQL（參數已代入）

                WITH IndicatorParsed AS (
                    SELECT
                        date,
                        code,
                        name,
                        CAST(close_price AS REAL) AS close_p,

                        -- 均線解析
                        CAST(json_extract(m_ma, '$.ma5') AS REAL) AS ma5,
                        CAST(json_extract(m_ma, '$.ma10') AS REAL) AS ma10,
                        CAST(json_extract(m_ma, '$.ma20') AS REAL) AS ma20,
                        LAG(CAST(json_extract(m_ma, '$.ma20') AS REAL)) OVER (PARTITION BY code ORDER BY date) AS prev_ma20,

                        -- 成交量解析
                        CAST(json_extract(s_vol, '$.current') AS REAL) AS vol_cur,
                        CAST(json_extract(s_vol, '$.ma5') AS REAL) AS vol_ma5,

                        -- MACD 柱狀體解析
                        CAST(json_extract(s_macd, '$.osc') AS REAL) AS osc,
                        LAG(CAST(json_extract(s_macd, '$.osc') AS REAL)) OVER (PARTITION BY code ORDER BY date) AS prev_osc,

                        -- KD 解析
                        CAST(json_extract(s_kd, '$.k') AS REAL) AS k_val,
                        CAST(json_extract(s_kd, '$.d') AS REAL) AS d_val,
                        LAG(CAST(json_extract(s_kd, '$.k') AS REAL)) OVER (PARTITION BY code ORDER BY date) AS prev_k,
                        LAG(CAST(json_extract(s_kd, '$.d') AS REAL)) OVER (PARTITION BY code ORDER BY date) AS prev_d

                    FROM otc_stock_daily
                ),
                PreCalculated AS (
                    SELECT
                        *,
                        -- 在此層明確算出 3 條均線的最大值與最小值，避免 WHERE 誤判為聚合
                        CASE
                            WHEN ma5 >= ma10 AND ma5 >= ma20 THEN ma5
                            WHEN ma10 >= ma5 AND ma10 >= ma20 THEN ma10
                            ELSE ma20
                        END AS ma_max,
                        CASE
                            WHEN ma5 <= ma10 AND ma5 <= ma20 THEN ma5
                            WHEN ma10 <= ma5 AND ma10 <= ma20 THEN ma10
                            ELSE ma20
                        END AS ma_min
                    FROM IndicatorParsed
                )
                SELECT
                    date,
                    code,
                    name,
                    close_p,
                    ma20,
                    ROUND(vol_cur / 1000, 0) AS vol_cur_k,
                    ROUND(vol_ma5 / 1000, 0) AS vol_ma5_k,
                    prev_osc,
                    osc,
                    k_val,
                    d_val
                FROM PreCalculated
                WHERE
                    -- date 欄位可能是 INTEGER，而 debug SQL 將日期代入後是文字常值；
                    -- 統一轉為文字，確保參數化執行與直接執行 debug SQL 結果一致。
                    CAST(date AS TEXT) = CAST('20261028' AS TEXT)
                    AND code GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
                    AND vol_cur >= 500000
                    -- 均線糾結度判斷
                    AND ((ma_max - ma_min) / ma_min) <= 0.035
                    AND ma20 >= prev_ma20
                    AND close_p >= ma20
                    AND ((close_p - ma20) / ma20) <= 0.04

                    -- 量能與動能指標
                    AND vol_cur >= (vol_ma5 * 1.2)
                    -- AND prev_osc <= 0
                    -- AND osc >= 0

                    -- KD 條件
                    AND k_val > d_val
                    AND k_val >= 30
                    AND k_val <= 45
                ORDER BY code ASC;
